review: The Monopoly promo is going on right now. It's a fun promo, so I wish I could access it. The home screen on my app shows my order from three hours ago and no other links to the Monopoly section. You'd think, in the very least, you'd put a link to your promos at the bottom of the homepage. You can do better McDs, I'm sure of it.

They temporarily fixed the inability to reach the Monopoly game mode when there is a recent order showing in the app by putting it on the home screen in the What's New section -- but now it's gone again!!
